title: RNeasy Mini Kit Protocol for Tissue RNA Extraction
author: Maysa Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ssceeaw

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sample and Lysate
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue sample ensuring the mass does not exceed 30 mg, adding the appropriate volume of RLT buffer based on tissue mass.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μl of RLT buffer if using less than 20 mg of tissue.
Add 700 μl of RLT buffer if the mass is larger than 20 mg (but not exceeding 30 mg).

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Disrupt and homogenize the tissue using an appropriate method.

substeps.instruction: Use TissueLyser LT, TissueLyser II, TissueRuptor, or a mortar and pestle followed by QIAshredder or needle and syringe.

steps.title: Add Ethanol to Lysate
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of 70% ethanol to the lysate and homogenize using a pipette.

steps.title: Load Sample onto Spin Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to an RNeasy Mini spin column and centrifuge to collect the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 μl of the sample, including any precipitate, to an RNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at 8000 g.
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Column with RW1 Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the column using RW1 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μl of RW1 buffer to the column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at 8000 g.
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Perform First RPE Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash with RPE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl of RPE buffer to the column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at 8000 g.
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Perform Second RPE Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the second wash with RPE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl of RPE buffer to the column.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 8000 g.

steps.title: Dry the Membrane (Optional)
steps.instruction: Optionally dry the membrane by centrifuging the column in a new collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at full speed for one minute.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA using RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 mL collector tube.
Add 30 to 50 μl RNase-free water.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 8000 g to elute the RNA.

steps.title: Optional Secondary Elution
steps.instruction: If more than 30 μg of RNA is expected, perform a second elution.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the elution step using another 30 to 50 μl of RNase-free water, or reuse the previous elution.
